answer: An answer must cite at least 2 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the shale index resolves every citation against the island checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the trellis audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 1621 identities would post 1817 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
